story: Discover the stunning Oriental Dollarbird (*Eurystomus orientalis*), a member of the diverse Coraciidae family. Native to Open woodland; forest edges; parks; gardens; mangroves; and riverine habitats, this bird faces various environmental challenges. Currently classified as Least Concern (LC) on the IUCN Red List, the Oriental Dollarbird represents the delicate balance of its native region. Understanding its habitat requirements and distribution is key to effective conservation planning. This species contributes to the richness of avian diversity, and this poster offers an artistic glimpse into its world.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
